item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Looking forward to seeing you at our 7/8 Cross Country practice today. Please meet in Room 144 at 2:15 and make sure you have a ride home for 3:30.

item.title: A message from Ms. Brennan:
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons Club meets today in Room 201! Come join an existing campaign, find a group to play with, or simply meet other students who enjoy D&D.

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok:
item.description: A reminder of the Varsity girls soccer practice from 2:30-3:45 after school today. If you tried out and did not speak with Mr. Kwok yesterday, please go to room 208 at the start of lunch today

item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: A reminder to all Grade 12 students to turn on their notifications to the Grade 12 Teams page. An item to be acted upon is in the General channel- we need all Grade 12 students to submit the gown sizing form with your height. If you don't know your height, visit the Guidance office to use the measuring tape on the wall.

item.title: Another message from Guidance:
item.description: Are you a grade 11 or 12 student interested in being a tutor this school year? We are looking to create a list of students who are available and interested in providing tutoring support. Tutoring can either be for volunteer hours or for an hourly rate. Check the Grade 11 or 12 Teams page or see Ms. Timmins or Mr. Spence for more information.
